issues.description: Class-naming mismatch for the concrete animal types: the problem statement UML and the template Main.java refer to animal classes named Seal, Pig, and Goat, but the solution repository provides implementations named SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat while leaving Seal.java, Pig.java, and Goat.java empty. This inconsistent naming of the same conceptual entities across artifacts will confuse students (they will look for Seal/Pig/Goat as specified and in the template) and may prevent straightforward mapping of the reference implementation to the assignment and tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make class names consistent across all artifacts. Option A (recommended): rename the solution classes SpaceSeal, SpacePig, and SpaceGoat to Seal, Pig, and Goat (updating constructors and message text as needed) and remove the empty Seal.java/Pig.java/Goat.java placeholders. Option B: if the 'Space' prefix is intentional, update the problem statement UML and the template Main.java to reference SpaceSeal/SpacePig/SpaceGoat so the specification, template, and solution use the same identifiers.
